stops.title: Yu Ɔvavyu
stops.caption: Yu branch, ɛn wetin i nid tide.
stops.speech: Yu ɔvavyu de opin pan yu branch: omɔch pipul de na di kɔngrigeshɔn, ɛn wetin de wet fɔ yu fɔ du tide.

stops.title: Yu Branch
stops.caption: Ɔltin insay di wan we yu de lid.
stops.speech: Mi Branch na di ol wan we yu de lid. In mɛmba dɛn, in grup dɛn, in sɛvis dɛn, ɛn di pipul we jɔs jɔyn.

stops.title: Di Dairɛktri
stops.caption: Ɔlman, wit dɛn stetɔs.
stops.speech: Di dairɛktri de lis ɔlman insay yu branch. Di layn de tɛl yu if na vizitɔ, ritɔna, ɔ pɔsin we dɔn du di mɛmbaship klas.

stops.title: Fɔlo ɔp dɛn
stops.caption: Tri lis, pan shɔt tɛm.
stops.speech: Fɔlo ɔp gɛt tri lis: fɔs-tɛm pipul we nɔbɔdi nɔ tɔk to, pipul we nɔ de na grup, ɛn ɛnibɔdi we dɔn let fɔ kɔntakt.

stops.title: Wɔri dɛn
stops.caption: Wɛlfɛa ɛn sefgadin, sɛpret.
stops.speech: Wɔri na usay wɛlfɛa ɛn sefgadin de sidɔm. Na tu sɛpret inbɔks pɔposli, ɛn difrɛn pipul de rid dɛn.

stops.title: Yu Fɛloship
stops.caption: Di grup we yu de lid.
stops.speech: Fɔ di fɛloship we yu de lid, yu kin tek di rɛjista, rɛkɔd fɔlo ɔp, ɛn si udat dɔn stɔp fɔ kam.

stops.title: Yu Dipatmɛnt
stops.caption: Mɛmba lis, rota ɛn rikrutmɛnt.
stops.speech: Fɔ yu dipatmɛnt yu de manej di mɛmba lis, put di rota awt, ɛn wok tru di pipul we de aplay fɔ jɔyn.

stops.title: Di Sol Paiplain
stops.caption: Frɔm fɔs kɔntakt go na dipatmɛnt.
stops.speech: Di sol paiplain de fɔlo pɔsin we wi rich tru ɛvanjelizm, frɔm di fɔs kɔntakt sote i jɔyn wan dipatmɛnt.

stops.title: Ripɔt dɛn
stops.caption: Yu branch, insay nɔmba.
stops.speech: Ripɔt de tɔn yu branch to nɔmba: atɛndans trɛnd, udat nɔ de kam, ɛn aw di grup dɛn de gro.
